run_sentencepiece_encoding: run the script to encode input text files using a SentencePiece model with multiprocessing
encode_lines_with_product_vocab: encode lines using a product vocabulary by specifying --product-vocab-size for subword factorization
encode_with_offset: encode text tokens and add a numeric offset to every output ID using the --offset flag
filter_empty_lines: filter out empty lines during encoding by omitting the --keep-empty flag
encode_multiple_inputs: encode multiple input files simultaneously by passing multiple paths to --inputs and --outputs
